name: R Draconis
generated_by: scripts.build_series (photometry of the target on SPHEREx DR1 exposures and coadds)
method: Aperture photometry (1.5 px radius, 4-7 px background annulus) of the target in each exposure, corrected by the PSF fraction on the aperture; neighbours inside the aperture subtracted with their coadd fluxes interpolated in wavelength. One point per exposure at its wavelength at the target's position. Errors include a 5 % systematic floor; exposures more than 5 robust sigma from those at nearby wavelengths are rejected.
